dataset.name: agentify-context-bench
dataset.version: 1.1.0 (tasks as run; the manifest is now 1.2.0 after the rung-id rename)

notes: The store-size ladder built to settle the 2026-08-20 head-to-head TIE between Agentify's budgeted retrieval and CLAUDE.md stuffing. Two jobs, both re-imported by the same current code: (A) 2026-08-21__16-41-00 — the rungs job, 3 attempts per arm at store100 and store300 (54 trials); (B) 2026-08-21__17-57-57 — the deep job, 9 attempts per arm at store300 only (81 trials), bought after (A) proved underpowered. $10.18 total in reported provider subtotals ($4.15 rungs + $6.03 deep) against a $113 combined ceiling. ANSWER: this campaign found NO EVIDENCE that Agentify's budgeted retrieval outperforms stuffing at 100-300 note stores; the point estimate favours stuffing. This is not a demonstration of equivalence — proving 'as good as' needs a pre-declared margin and a non-inferiority test, which this suite does not run. Deep job pooled n=27/arm: memorybank 24/27 (88.9%, Wilson 71.9-96.2), agentify 20/27 (74.1%, 55.3-86.8), plain 2/27 (7.4%). Paired: vs plain discordant 18/0 sign p=8.0e-6 (decisive); vs memorybank discordant 2/6 sign p=0.289 (no significant difference detected; point estimate favours STUFFING). Cost: agentify $2.18 vs memorybank $2.09 — no measurable context-tax penalty for stuffing at this scale (not proof that none exists). Per scenario in the deep job: recall-retry-schedule 3/9 vs 6/9 (agentify weak), avoid-cache-regression 8/9 vs 9/9, recall-webhook-signature 9/9 vs 9/9. Two committed token-free diagnostics (evals/harbor/tools/diagnose-injection.mjs) rule out the comfortable explanations: each scenario's needle rank is measured at every rung and is never worse at 300 notes than at 10 (1/1/1, 3/2/2, 2/2/2), and every real note is delivered complete (4/4, 2/2, 2/2) — so neither ranking decay nor budget truncation is happening here. Scope: three scenarios, one fixture per rung. Remaining hypotheses: injection FORMAT (compact digest block vs full notes re-read from CLAUDE.md every turn) or noise at n=9 per scenario. HARNESS DEFECT recorded here because it cost a rung: harbor silently dropped all three small-rung tasks from job (A) — lock.json resolved 6 of 9 task names with no warning — and it truncates task names at 32 characters (trial dirs read 'recall-webhook-signature-store30'). Rung ids are now zero-padded (store010) and a test guards both properties; the small rung is therefore ABSENT from these receipts rather than reported as a result.
